title: WP900 G10 staged minimal-state repair must not relabel executor child PID as trial-process identity
target: F2-WP-900 G10 minimal behavior-state repair staged by b8da89cc7ff0493ff9a15505cd34ea9a4cd40ebd

material_observation.staged_rewrite: The staged repair removes trial_process_identity from MediatedSemanticState, but then constructs IndependentSemanticMediatorCrossoverCandidate.trial_process_identities as executor-child-pid:<receipt.child_pid>.
material_observation.why_invalid: The child PID belongs to the behavioral executor child process. It is not evidence of the independently observed verifier/trial process instance required by the current G10 target topology gate. Relabeling it as trial_process_identity collapses two required causal/process roles and can make repository candidate structure look stronger without adding independent topology evidence.
material_observation.scope: This does not invalidate the minimal-state objective itself. It invalidates only the substitution of executor-child identity for verifier/trial identity and any later topology claim derived from it.

required_correction: Do not synthesize trial_process_identities from executor child PIDs.

Keep verifier/trial process identity outside MediatedSemanticState but pass it to verifier-side crossover binding through an explicit verifier-only topology evidence argument/surface, or omit trial-process identity from repository candidate structure until target execution provides it.
Maintain three distinct roles in target evidence: source process instance, verifier/trial process instance, executor child process instance.
Require anti-PID-reuse identity at target scope (boot/start/namespace or equivalent); repository logical labels and raw child PID uniqueness remain zero target-topology credit.
Add a regression that fails if trial_process_identities are equal to, derived from, or merely renamed child_pids.
duplicate_authority_check: Review-only evidence. No source/test/workflow/active-pointer mutation, no G11 and no runtime dispatch created.
next_exact_action: Existing G10 owner preserves the minimal-state repair but removes the executor-child-as-trial-identity substitution before accepting the repaired repository candidate; target topology identity remains external verifier/readback evidence.
